messages.subject: spectrogram whitelevel / brightness / sensitivity
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,
I just discovered this great package and would like to use it for
speech analysis esp. to produce graphics for publications. However, I
would need to find away to reduce the whitelevel of the spectrogram,
i.e. I just don't see enough details in the spectrogram. Is there away
to increse the "sensitivity". Setting dB to "D" helps a bit but not
enough and anyway I'm not sure what this does.

Thanks in advance,
Lasse

> Hi all,

> would need to find away to reduce the whitelevel of the spectrogram,
> i.e. I just don't see enough details in the spectrogram. Is there away

>

> Lasse
>
>

Hi,

You can use the set a lower dB minimal value using the argument 'collevels'

library(seewave)
data(peewit)
# default ouput
spectro(peewit)
# output with a dB scale from -60 to 0 by step of 1
spectro(peewit, collevels=seq(-60,0,1))

Let me know if this was what you were expecting.

Best regards

Jerome

Might be tcltk...

The Mac OS X download webpage (http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/)
says about R-2.11.1.pkg
"This package *only* contains the R framework, 32-bit GUI (R.app) and
64-bit GUI (R64.app). *For Tcl/Tk libraries (needed if you want to use
tcltk) and GNU Fortran (needed if you want to compile packages from
sources that contain FORTRAN code) please see the tools directory
<http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/tools>*."

So you probably need to install this:
http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/tools/tcltk-8.5.5-x11.dmg

Let me know if this solves the problem

Best

Jerome

messages.subject: envelope vs oscillogram - defining colors
messages.body_plain:
Dear list members,

I have a question about one of the functions of the seewave.
When I use the "oscillo" function, I would like to have a plot with
the actual oscillogram in black and the actual envelope in red or
another color. Based on the manual that I have, the colors should be
defined using the "colwave" argument. But actually when I use it, let
say, choosing the color "red", not only the envelope is red but all
the oscillogram. Now, how can I define different colors for the
oscillogram an for the envelope? I'm running seewave under ubuntu
10.01 and working with sperm whale clicks.
Many thanks for your kind help,

Nino

messages.subject: Re: [seewave] envelope vs oscillogram - defining colors
messages.body_plain:
Dear Nino

The function oscillo() only plots the oscillogram, not the envelope.
The envelope can be obtained through the function env().

Here is a way to get what you need

data(tico)
oscillo(tico, f=22050)
par(new=TRUE)
env(tico, f=22050, colwave=2)

This is actually taken from an example provided on seewave webpage:
http://rug.mnhn.fr/seewave/
tab EXAMPLES

Hope this helps

Best

Jerome
